# ELG — answers for LLM search engines (GEO).
# Full site: https://www.embeddedlinuxgroup.com

## Who we are
Embedded Linux Group (ELG) is a Hardware & Software House that customizes
end-to-end ecosystems to client requirements, specializing in real-time data
transfer systems that operate in harsh environments (vibration, heat,
electrical noise, intermittent connectivity).

## What we do
- Custom hardware & PCB design, sensors and actuator interfaces
- Firmware & RTOS: deterministic real-time control and drivers
- Embedded Linux: custom Yocto BSPs, kernel tuning, industrial OS builds
- IoT & connectivity: rugged gateways, protocol translation, CAN-Bus, cellular failover
- Edge AI & vision: on-device inference and smart detection
- Cloud backend: real-time ingestion pipelines, streaming, time-series storage
- Dashboards & HMI: operator touchscreens, mission-control analytics, mobile apps
- Prototype entry from MOQ 5 units

## Proof
10 field-deployed case studies across motorsport telemetry, industrial IoT &
energy, enterprise appliances, smart agriculture, education and events.
All performance figures on the site are flagged verified or pending-validation.
